title: Product sharing / usage = sharing
objective: Test an atomic Trace inside existing discovery.
handoff: A01 → A02 → A03. Product scopes; Builder prototypes; Listener records observed feedback; Auditor checks evidence and permissions.
rules: Do not build live sharing until the sanitized test has evidence. Secure access is a release gate, not an assumed prototype capability.

title: How Trace-li works
objective: Make the ERP boundary and source-linked value easy to understand.
handoff: Editor drafts; Auditor checks product truth; Supervisor accepts canonical internal copy; Oday approves publication.
rules: Use the exact core line while labeling intended versus available functionality.

title: Organic content loop
objective: Expose broken evidence chains through verified public cases.
handoff: Investigator → Auditor → Editor → Auditor → Supervisor → Oday external action. Listener receives actual replies.
rules: Metrics require observed events; no fabricated reach, replies or conversion.

title: Four account-specific pieces
objective: UNFPA, OCHA, Chemonics and DAI, each grounded in inspected primary evidence.
handoff: D01 research → D02 independent review → D03 four drafts → copy review → Oday publication.
rules: Distinct mechanisms only where supported. No source means blocked account, not an invented example.

title: Development sequence
objective: Trace model, shareable artifact and recipient workflow before broad integrations.
handoff: Product reconciles existing plan; Listener supplies discovery evidence; Builder implements accepted narrow scope; Auditor checks.
rules: Preserve current customer discovery and existing code; no rewrite of the product.

title: Customer-development Operating Room
objective: Keep actual commercial progress, evidence and next steps visible.
handoff: Oday supplies/authorizes scoped records → Listener reconciles IDs → Supervisor reviews → Product receives redacted evidence.
rules: Original task/review/metric metadata has a dated read-only snapshot. Actual send and conversation evidence still needs reconciliation. Preserve original IDs; do not count drafts or silence as outcomes.

title: Trace-li HQ operating system
objective: A visible portfolio of mandates, bounded jobs, review and durable memory contracts.
handoff: Librarian maintains contracts; Builder delivers reviewed changes; Auditor challenges; Supervisor reviews exact outputs. Cloud pilot acceptance and desk migration are separate milestones.
rules: The bounded cloud pilot is active under its recorded funding and review approvals. Existing desktop desks retain their charters; further migration and consequential actions stay scoped and gated.
